summary: Short kerb outside houses, beside a school bus and loading zone.

best_section.where: Swann Road west kerb, outside the houses opposite the school tennis courts

drivers.seclusion: Three detached dwellings sit 6, 8 and 10 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is on a through road beside a bus zone and loading zone; little room.
drivers.traffic: Busy school street with a bus route and drop-off loading.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the opposite side near the courts, but this side is signed bus and loading zone.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m rule it out
Bus Zone and 2 min loading zone signs
Gate mapped 5 m away, not on only access
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade from the east over the road in the morning.
